title: The inspector reads workflows and ticket files through light modules
intention: The inspector stops reaching the crossing machinery: the workflow grammar and the ticket-file helpers move out of cairn/tools/base/transitions.py into two light modules that import nothing that can post, so no import path runs from the inspector to transitions, gate_probes or the bus socket.
why: So the inspector's verdict path cannot reach a host. Today it does, by import: inspector -> transitions -> gate_probes -> bus_client.remote (socket). Akien's answer to open-495f7be4789b is that the inspector stops reaching emit, and outline 17.1.1 says the inspector outputs only findings. test_inspector_nexus is red until this lands, and 339a45cee6a1's PROVED waits on it.
traces_to: Akien 2026-10-27, outline 17.1.1 and his answer to open-495f7be4789b: the inspector outputs only findings and stops reaching emit. Law 8 (the verdict path may not consult a host; test_inspector_nexus is that proof). RULE 1 (callers outside base ask through base's declared public interface). Precedent ticket 03ea6f93df03 (a light door re-exported, callers repointed).
how: New cairn/tools/base/workflow_grammar.py takes, verbatim, the grammar: MalformedWorkflow, IllegalTransition, TERMINAL_STATES, is_terminal, is_summons, Workflow, parse_workflow with its regexes and phase vocabulary, and the crossing fingerprint pair. New cairn/tools/base/ticket_file.py takes find_ticket, ticket_shape and write_ticket (the artifact door import stays inside write_ticket). transitions.py imports them back under their old names, so every existing caller keeps working and the objects are the same objects. The five import edges measured 2026-10-27 from the inspector into transitions are repointed: inspector.py and skill_block.py to workflow_grammar; crossings.py, chain.py and ticket_log.py to ticket_file. The base charter's public_interface names both modules.
falsifier: Green when cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_light_modules_keep_the_crossing_off_the_inspector_path.py passes under PROVES {'632edb992aa3': {'1','2','3','4','5'}}: (1) workflow_grammar.py imports only the standard library; (2) ticket_file.py's import closure (import_sieve.reaches) contains neither cairn/tools/base/transitions.py, nor cairn/tools/base/gate_probes.py, nor any file under cairn/tools/bus_client/; (3) transitions.parse_workflow, is_terminal, MalformedWorkflow, IllegalTransition, Workflow, TERMINAL_STATES, verify_crossing_fingerprint, _find_ticket, _ticket_shape and _write_ticket are the very objects defined in workflow_grammar / ticket_file; (4) crossings.py and ticket_log.py import nothing from cairn.tools.base.transitions; (5) the base charter's public_interface names both modules. Also green: cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector_nexus.py, with _FIRE_PATH unchanged. Hollow: before the build both modules are absent, so 1-5 red and the nexus fire-path tooth reds on inspector -> transitions -> gate_probes -> bus_client.remote.
watchme: none, because the outcome is measured by cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector_nexus.py, which the commit hook reseals on every commit touching build_inspector, so a new edge back onto the inspector's path reds there without a probe
children: none, because the build is two new files plus import lines, at the addresses named in D2 and D5

decisions.text: The cut is two modules, not one. Measured 2026-10-27 with import_sieve.reaches: five edges lead from the inspector into transitions. Two need only the grammar (inspector.py, skill_block.py) and three need only the ticket-file helpers (crossings.py, chain.py, ticket_log.py via rehearsal.py). A grammar module alone would leave the red standing. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

NEW cairn/tools/base/workflow_grammar.py takes these from transitions.py, verbatim: _HEADER_RE, _STATE_RE, _PHASES, _WRITABLE_PHASES, _RELEASE_PHASES, MalformedWorkflow, IllegalTransition, TERMINAL_STATES, is_terminal, is_summons, the Workflow dataclass, parse_workflow, _FINGERPRINT_EXCLUDE, _crossing_fingerprint and verify_crossing_fingerprint. It imports only the standard library. NEW cairn/tools/base/ticket_file.py takes _TICKETS (rooted the same way: Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3].parent / 'CairnCommons' / 'tickets'), _TICKET_SHAPES, _find_ticket as find_ticket, _ticket_shape as ticket_shape, and _write_ticket as write_ticket. Its only import outside the standard library is IllegalTransition from workflow_grammar at module level; write_ticket keeps 'from cairn.tools.artifact import artifact as door' inside its body. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

Exception identity is kept by moving IllegalTransition itself into workflow_grammar. transitions.py imports it back, and every IllegalTransition subclass left in transitions.py (EntryGateRed and the rest) keeps inheriting from that one class, so 'except transitions.IllegalTransition' still catches what ticket_file.ticket_shape raises. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

transitions.py deletes the moved definitions and imports them back under their old names, near its other imports: 'from cairn.tools.base.workflow_grammar import (...)' for every name in D2, and 'from cairn.tools.base.ticket_file import find_ticket as _find_ticket, ticket_shape as _ticket_shape, write_ticket as _write_ticket, _TICKETS, _TICKET_SHAPES'. The old names are then the same objects, and every caller of transitions keeps working unchanged. Nothing else in transitions.py changes. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

Exactly these import lines change. inspector.py:95 becomes 'from cairn.tools.base.workflow_grammar import MalformedWorkflow, is_terminal, parse_workflow', keeping its trailing comment. inspector.py:239 becomes 'from cairn.tools.base.workflow_grammar import verify_crossing_fingerprint'. skill_block.py:468 and :496 import the same names from cairn.tools.base.workflow_grammar. crossings.py:346 and chain.py:413 become 'from cairn.tools.base.ticket_file import write_ticket as _write_ticket'. crossings.py:368 and chain.py:414 become 'from cairn.tools.base.ticket_file import ticket_shape as _shape_of'. ticket_log.py:56 becomes 'from cairn.tools.base.ticket_file import find_ticket as _find_ticket', with its comment changed to '# at call time'. Docstrings and comments that name transitions._write_ticket are left as they are. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

The proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_light_modules_keep_the_crossing_off_the_inspector_path.py is written and committed red-first before BUILDME. The builder does not write or edit it; it only runs it with bin/cairn test <path>. It binds the new modules at call time, so the hollow reading reds the teeth instead of crashing. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

The base charter cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json gets 'cairn.tools.base.workflow_grammar' and 'cairn.tools.base.ticket_file' appended to public_interface. Read it with json.load, append both strings, and write it with cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(str(path), json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', verb='cast', why='public_interface declares workflow_grammar and ticket_file'), run from python with PYTHONPATH=. at the repo root. Then run cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'

PROVEME's proven_by is the new proof plus cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_inspector_nexus.py, the fire-path tooth this fix turns green. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-27 'yes, cast child 3 and go go go!'
